hypotheses.statement: A 20 mL/kg transfusion raises haemoglobin enough to delay the next transfusion.
Fewer transfusions per infant follow from the larger volume.

against.says: higher-volume arm, lower mortality, in children

rivals.statement: Unit transfusion thresholds, not the volume, set the number of transfusions.
rivals.why_plausible: The comparisons found differ by centre and period, which also changes thresholds.

repairable_variants.statement: The gain holds only for infants above 1,000 g.
repairable_variants.repairs: Volume tolerance may depend on weight.
